name: repeat-rows
title: Repeat Rows
description: Add-another rows (line items, guests) with min and max limits, Undo after a remove, duplicate rows flagged with a one-tap remove, blank rows called out before submit, Enter that adds a row instead of submitting, and focus that lands on the right field.

meta.stops: Duplicate line items in add-another form
meta.summary: Reduces lost, doubled and blank entries in add-another forms with undoable removes, duplicate flags and min/max limits.
catches: Duplicate rows, compared case- and space-insensitively on uniqueBy keys
Blank rows, with a one-tap clean-up
Accidental removes, with Undo in place
Enter in the last row adding a row instead of submitting
limits: Duplicate check compares only the keys you list in uniqueBy
Validation of field contents is up to you
a11y: Each row is a group labelled "Item n of m"; inputs carry per-row aria-labels
Enter moves to the next row or adds one; focus moves to the new or next logical field after add/remove
Remove buttons have aria-labels and disable at the minimum
Duplicate and blank notices render in polite live regions
